Hydration Infusion

£119

The Hydration Infusion is our foundation drip. It delivers one litre of electrolyte-rich solution directly into the bloodstream to restore fluid and mineral balance. It is a great choice after exercise, travel, illness or a demanding week when you feel run down and dehydrated. This electrolyte-rich solution closely matches the electrolyte profile of blood plasma so it rehydrates the body efficiently. Delivering it intravenously means fluid reaches your circulation straight away rather than relying on absorption through the gut. Potassium contributes to normal muscle function and the normal functioning of the nervous system. Calcium contributes to normal muscle function and normal energy-yielding metabolism.

What's in it

Ingredients

  • Electrolyte-Rich Solution (1 litre)
  • Sodium Chloride (242mmol)
  • Potassium (5mmol)
  • Calcium (2mmol)
  • Bicarbonate (29mmol)

Ingredient guide

Electrolyte-Rich Solution

A balanced solution whose sodium, potassium, calcium, chloride and lactate content closely reflects that of blood plasma. It replenishes the electrolytes the body relies on for nerve signalling, muscle contraction and fluid balance.
